name: Arugula Salad with White Beans, Roasted Peppers, Olives & Pine Nuts
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)

Trim, seed, and slice bell peppers lengthwise into thin strips. Transfer to a large baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, then season with salt and pepper. Toss to combine and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until peppers are tender and charred in spots, 18-20 minutes.
Meanwhile, juice the lemons into a large bowl.
Peel and mince shallots. Add to the bowl with the lemon juice along with oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Drain and rinse beans. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Halve olives lengthwise. Add to the bowl, along with the capers, and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add pine nuts. Cook, stirring constantly, until golden brown, about 5 minutes. Add to the bowl.
When the peppers are done, remove from the oven and set aside to cool, 5 minutes.
Using a peeler, shave the Parmesan into curls.
Add cooled peppers and arugula to the bowl, then toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls and top with Parmesan. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
